label: Kiko (3D: a little idol twirls, dances and brings the letter)

preset.title: Kiko's Encore
preset.intro: Lay the card flat, point your phone at it, and give Kiko a stage.
body: A very small idol skipped all the way across this card to sing you one thing.
You are my favourite person in every crowd. Happy birthday, superstar.

groups.title: The board
groups.note: The words on the board that springs up while Kiko cheers. Up to about 40 letters; longer words get smaller.

rows.label: Board
rows.value: Cậu là ngôi sao của tớ!
